name: Corrosive Blood
description:
Chances to miss reduced by 25%.
Immunity to POISON and CORROSION.
Attacks have a 20% chance to inflict CORROSION for 3 turns (up to 5 stacks).
Attacks have a 40% chance to inflict ENFEEBLE for 2 turns (up to 3 stacks).

CORROSION: Increases damage taken by 4% per stack.
ENFEEBLE: Reduces Constitution, Dexterity, and Intelligence by 5% per stack.
